name: Donchian breakout long-only with SMA200 filter
author: gabrielweich (jesse-strategies)
license: MIT (repo LICENSE; individual authors per README)
indicators: Donchian channel (default jesse period 20) computed on candles[:-1] (excludes current bar); SMA(200)
entry_long: close > previous-bar Donchian upperband AND close > SMA200
exit: liquidate when close < Donchian lowerband (computed on candles[:-1])
implementation_notes: All-in sizing; 'lowerband' exit period equals entry period (20) unlike Turtle 10. Jesse note: README states these are code examples, not profitable strategies.
